approval.title: Internal approval
approval.staffHint: Only the director sends to the agency. Build the campaign and ask for approval.
approval.ownerHint: You are the director: you can send straight to the agency.
approval.askHint: The director gets a notice. Until they decide, the draft is locked for the team.
approval.approveTitle: Approve and send to the agency
approval.approveHint: The campaign goes to the agency now, with your name as the approver.
approval.returnHint: Say what to change. Whoever built it gets a notice.
approval.asked: Approval request sent to the director.

decided.approve: Campaign approved and sent to the agency.
decided.withdraw: Request withdrawn. The draft can be edited again.

approval.lockedStaff: Waiting for the director: the draft is locked. Withdraw the request to edit.
approval.ownerPendingHint: Review the draft below; you can adjust it before approving.
approval.askIncomplete: To ask for approval, fill in name, objective, start date, one network and one deliverable.

shortlists.title: Shortlist
shortlists.description: Lists of catalog creators for the director to approve. Approved ones become a campaign.
shortlists.titleInvalid: Use a name with 3 to 120 characters.
shortlists.emptyHint: Build a list with the creators that fit and send it to the director.
shortlists.unavailableHint: Lists show up as soon as the database is updated.
shortlists.counts: {items, plural, one {# creator} other {# creators}} · {approved} approved · {rejected} declined
shortlists.campaignCreated: Campaign draft created with the approved creators.
shortlists.addHint: Add creators from their catalog profile (“Add to shortlist”).
shortlists.sendTitle: Send the list to the director
shortlists.sendHint: The director gets a notice and decides on each creator. Once sent, the list can't change.
shortlists.deleteHint: Only lists in progress can be deleted.
shortlists.toCampaignTitle: Create campaign with the approved creators
shortlists.toCampaignHint: Creates a draft with the first approved creator as the chosen one. When sent to the agency, all approved creators go as suggestions.
shortlists.campaignLinked: This list already became a campaign.
shortlists.compareHint: Compare 2 to 4 creators from this list.
shortlists.ownerHint: You are the director: approve or decline each creator.
shortlists.staffWaiting: With the director. You'll get a notice when they decide.
shortlists.draftHint: In progress: add creators and send to the director.
shortlists.fromShortlistHint: When sent to the agency, the approved creators go as suggestions too.

compare.title: Compare creators
compare.description: Side by side, only with what each media kit allows.
compare.needMore: Pick 2 to 4 creators in the catalog to compare.
compare.missing: {count, plural, one {# creator left the catalog and was left out.} other {# creators left the catalog and were left out.}}
compare.undeclared: No schedule declared: check with the agency.
compare.valueRule: Agreed with the agency (the catalog shows no prices).
compare.ratingValue: {avg} of 5 · {count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}}
compare.campaignsCount: {count, plural, =0 {None yet} one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}

rating.title: Rate creators
rating.hint: One rating per published or proven deliverable. The average shows in the catalog and to the agency.
rating.pickOnTime: Say whether it met the deadline and give 1 to 5 stars.
rating.waiting: Rating opens when the deliverable is published.
rating.summary: {avg} of 5 · {count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}} · {pct}% on time
rating.historyHint: Campaigns with you and your team's ratings.
rating.agencyHint: Each brand rates published deliverables: deadline and quality from 1 to 5.
rating.agencySummary: {avg} of 5 · {count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}} from {brands, plural, one {# brand} other {# brands}} · {pct}% on time
